items.name: Robust standby-power data-center orders, Q2 2026
items.claim: Cummins reported record results driven by robust customer orders for standby power for data centers, alongside improving North American truck markets, per CEO Jennifer Rumsey's second-quarter earnings statement.
items.source_excerpt: Cummins delivered record second-quarter results, reflecting robust customer orders for standby power for data centers and improving North American truck markets,

notes: Q2 2026 8-K earnings release is the only stored evidence for Cummins. It names standby-power (backup/reciprocating genset) demand from data centers as an order driver but discloses no dollar backlog, RPO, or named contract figure.
